items.question: Which WNBA teams did Tan White play for?
items.answer: The Indiana Fever drafted Tan White second overall in 2005, and she made the 2005 WNBA All-Rookie Team. She played for Indiana (2005 to 2008), the Connecticut Sun (2009 to 2013) and the Minnesota Lynx (2014), averaging 8.1 points in 320 regular-season games.

items.question: Where did Tan White play college basketball?
items.answer: Tan White played at Mississippi State from 2001 to 2005. As a senior she led the nation in scoring, earned Kodak All-America honors and won the Frances Pomeroy Naismith Award. Mississippi State inducted her into its sports hall of fame in 2016.

items.question: Where is Tan White from?
items.answer: Tan White is from Tupelo, Mississippi. She was born there on September 27, 1982, and played at Tupelo High School.
